name: What materials are needed for a typical drywall hole repair?

mainEntity.name: What materials are needed for a typical drywall hole repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard drywall hole repair typically requires a few key materials: a drywall patch kit (for smaller holes), new drywall pieces (for larger holes), joint compound (also known as mud), drywall tape (paper or fiberglass mesh), sandpaper or sanding sponges, and primer. Depending on the damage, you might also need furring strips or backing wood for support, and appropriate tools for cutting and finishing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical drywall hole repair needs drywall patches or new drywall, joint compound, tape, sandpaper, and primer, plus tools for cutting and finishing.
